name: starter-pack
description: A few reliable starting points for image and short video generation.
author: miraga-kivo

prompts.title: Product flat lay
prompts.template: {product} on {surface}, {props}, overhead flat lay, soft diffused light, clean {color} background, commercial product photography

prompts.title: Natural portrait
prompts.template: portrait of {person}, {expression}, close-up, 85mm, shallow depth of field, window light from the left, 35mm film grain

variables.person: a young woman with curly hair

prompts.title: Product hero orbit
prompts.template: slow orbit around {product} on a {surface}, soft studio light, subtle reflections, dark gradient background, commercial look
